d:
I built a ₹1.5 lakh gaming PC using Gigabyte components, pairing the Ryzen 5 9600X with the Radeon RX 9070 GRE to see just how much gaming performance you can get at this budget in 2026. From the build itself to thermals, performance and real-world 1440p gaming, let’s see what this setup can actually do.
And yes... this entire PC costs about half of an iPhone Duo.
Parts list and Pricing at the time of shooting
CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 9600X - ~₹19k
GPU: Gigabyte AMD Radeon RX 9070 GRE GAMING OC 12G - ~₹62.5k
Motherboard: Gigabyte B850 Gaming X WiFi 6E - ~₹16.5k
RAM: XPG 16GB DDR5 6000Mhz - ~₹30k
